member.title: Team Guide
member.html:
Who reads what. Read sections 1–12 and keep the Quick Reference Card handy. Team Leaders and Managers have their own guides, with the delete passwords.
What's new in version 2. TC Checklist now looks and works like the Universal Team Hub. There are no tick boxes: a question is done as soon as its answer box has text. It opens on a Properties list with Open / Closed / Cancelled tabs and a search box; edits save as you type and appear live for everyone; a property can be marked Closed or Cancelled; Print / PDF shows every answer in full; names come from the Team Hub; Help opens your role's guide inside the app; and deleting uses the Team Hub's delete passwords. The header matches the Team Hub too: one Live clock that also shows whether everything is saved. Every question, and every answer already saved, is exactly where it was.

1What TC Checklist Does

TC Checklist is the script for the seller's first call. It walks you through every question to ask, keeps each answer with the property, and shares it live with the whole team.

One list per propertyMortgage, Pictures, Emergency Contact, HOA, SFHs, Land, Income Producing Properties and Mobile Homes: 79 questions, each with its own answer box.
Live for everyoneEvery answer saves as you type and shows on your teammates' screens at once. Two people can work the same property without overwriting each other.
Open to ClosedEvery property starts Open. Mark it Closed or Cancelled when the deal ends; it moves to its own tab and becomes view-only.

What you get

  • A Properties page with every first call the team has started, searchable by address, CRM link or any answer.
  • For every property: the CRM lead link, how many questions are answered, when it was last updated and by whom, and its status.
  • A printable record of the call, with every answer in full.
  • A Live clock: Eastern time from the server, the same for everyone, that turns colour to show whether everything is saved.
Important. The checklist is a guide for the call, not a contract. Confirm anything important (payoffs, HOA approvals, zoning) with the source before it goes into a deal.

2Signing In

Only company Google accounts (@totalchb.com) can open it. There is no separate password.

  1. Go to tc.totalchb.com and bookmark it (or install it: section 11).
  2. Click Sign In With Google and pick your @totalchb.com account.
  3. You stay signed in on that browser.
  4. On a shared computer, click your initials at the top right, then Sign Out, and confirm.
Tip. A personal Gmail or any other account is turned away with "Access Denied. @totalchb.com emails only." Sign in again with your company account.

3Finding Your Way Around

WhereWhat it's for
LogoClick it from anywhere to go back to the Properties page.
Live clockEastern time from the server, the same on every device (a phone shows the time only). Its colour is the save status: green and glowing, everything is saved; purple, saving; red, offline or not saved (section 7). Click it for the details and when a change was last saved.
ActiveHow many teammates are online now. Click it to see who, and whether they're on a phone or a computer. On a phone it's Who's Online in your photo menu.
Sun / moonLight or dark look. It follows your device at first; your choice is remembered on that browser. On a phone it's the Light / Dark switch at the top of your photo menu.
Your initialsYour name, email and role (from the Team Hub), My Settings, Help, and Sign Out (it asks first).

When you scroll, the header slims down and stays at the top, and the tabs line stays just under it.

My Settings

Click your initials, then My Settings. It shows your name, email and role. There's nothing to set here yet: your name, photo and role come from the Team Hub.

Help

Click your initials, then Help. It opens the guide for your role inside the app, like the Team Hub: the Team Guide for Members, the Team Leader Guide or the Manager Guide (your role comes from the Team Hub). Pick a section on the left, or scroll. Team Leaders and Managers also see the delete passwords they may use.

The guide PDFs are along the top of Help, each with Open and Download. Your own guide is marked Yours; for Team Leaders and Managers, your copy ends with a Your Delete Passwords page, added only when you open or download it. Team Leaders can also get the Team Guide, and Managers all three (without passwords).

4The Properties Page

Home. Every property the team has started, newest activity first.

PartWhat it shows
Open / Closed / CancelledThe three lists. The number on each tab is how many properties it holds. Every property starts in Open.
The numbers beside the tabsOpen and Closed properties, and a ring with how far the Open ones are on average. The tabs and numbers stay pinned under the header as you scroll.
SearchType any part of an address, a CRM link or an answer. It searches the tab you're on and shows where it matched.
A property cardThe address, its status, when it was last updated and by whom, a ring and a bar with how many of the 79 questions are answered (green at 100%), and Open In CRM.
Tip. Click anywhere on a card to open its checklist. Open In CRM opens the lead in GoHighLevel in a new tab instead.
Tip. Moving between properties: on a property, Previous and Next step through the list you opened it from (the same tab and search, in the same order), and Jump To lists them all with a search box, so you don't need to go back to Properties. The list stays in the same order while you work, even as answers save.

5Starting A New Property

Start one as soon as the first call is booked.

  1. On the Properties page, click New Property.
  2. Type the property address exactly as it should appear, for example 1420 Sample Palm Dr, Exampleton FL 33000.
  3. Click Create. The checklist opens, ready for the call.
  4. Paste the GoHighLevel lead into CRM Lead Link at the top.
Important. The address can't be changed after it's created, because it's how the property is saved. If you make a typo, create the property again with the right address and delete the wrong one (section 10).
Good to know. If the address already exists, Create simply opens it, so you never get two copies of the same property.
An old unsaved checklist. If you'd started a checklist before version 2 without typing an address, a yellow note on the Properties page offers Start A Property With It, which brings those answers into a new property.

6Working The First Call

  1. Work down the sections. Each one shows how many of its questions are answered (for example 6 / 7), with a bar that fills as you go. A finished section turns green.
  2. Click a section's title to open or close it. Expand All and Collapse All are at the top.
  3. Type the seller's answer in the box under the question. It grows to fit long answers.
  4. As soon as a box has text, the question is done: its circle turns green with a check. Empty it, and the question is open again. There's nothing to tick.
  5. Paste a link (photos, a statement, a listing) and an open-link button appears in the box.
  6. Under What is The Monthly Escrow Payments, put the HOI and Taxes amounts in their own boxes.
Done = answered. An answer is what marks a question done. If the seller has nothing to add, type a short answer such as No, N/A or Not yet, so the team can see it was asked. Spaces alone don't count.
Good to know. The escrow question is done when any of its boxes has text: its own answer, HOI or Taxes. Questions that were ticked in the earlier version still count as done, even if their box is empty.
Tip. Mobile Homes: treat it like an SFH with all those questions, then add the Mobile Homes ones.

7Saving And Working Together

There is no Save button. Every answer saves on its own, a moment after you stop typing.

The Live clock at the top shows it. Click the clock for the details and when a change was last saved.

The clock isWhat it means
Green and glowing (Live)Everything is saved for the whole team.
Purple (Saving…)A change is on its way.
Red (Offline)No answer from the server yet. Your changes wait here and go through as soon as you're back online.
Red (Not Saved)The change didn't reach the server. It keeps trying on its own; click the clock, then Retry Now to try straight away. Nothing you typed is thrown away.
  • Teammates see your answers as you type, and you see theirs, without reloading.
  • Two people on the same property: each answer is saved on its own, so nobody overwrites anyone. The box you're typing in is never changed under you.
  • Leaving while it says Saving…: the browser asks you to wait. Let it finish.

8Closing Or Cancelling A Property

When a deal closes or falls through, take it off the Open list.

  1. Open the property and click Status: Open.
  2. Pick Mark Closed or Mark Cancelled, then confirm.
  3. It moves to the Closed or Cancelled tab and becomes view-only: nobody can change it by accident.
  4. To work on it again, open it and click Reopen.

9Printing Or Saving A PDF

For the deal file, or to send to someone on the deal.

  1. Open the property and click Print / PDF.
  2. In the print window, pick your printer, or Save as PDF as the destination.
  • The top shows the address, CRM link, status, how many questions are answered, when it was last updated and when it was printed.
  • Every answer prints in full, however long.
  • Sections with nothing filled in are left out, to keep it short.
Important. The printout holds the seller's details. Keep it inside the company and only send it to people on the deal.

10Deleting A Property

Deleting removes the property and every answer for the whole team, for good. Most of the time, Mark Cancelled is the better choice: it's off the Open list but still there if you need it.

Deleting follows the Team Hub's rules: only Team Leaders and Managers can delete a property, with the TC Team Leader password (the same one as in the Team Hub). Anyone with their own delete password uses that instead, and Remy only confirms.

If you click Delete, the app explains this and offers Mark Cancelled Instead.

Tip. If a property really has to go (say, a mistyped address), ask your Team Leader to delete it.

11On A Phone

Same link, same sign-in. The header is one row: the logo, the Live clock (time only) and your initials. Who's Online and the Light / Dark switch are in your photo menu. Menus slide up from the bottom, and answer boxes use a larger text size so the phone doesn't zoom in.

Tip. To put it on your home screen: in Safari tap Share → Add to Home Screen; in Chrome open the three-dot menu → Install app or Add to Home screen.

12Getting The Newest Version

TC Checklist checks for a new version every time it opens. When one arrives while you're using it, a note says A New Version Is Ready: click Reload.

Tip. If something looks out of date, do a hard reload once: Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac. On a phone, close the app fully and open it again.

13Good Habits

  • Start the property before the call, with the CRM link, so the team can find it.
  • Answer every question you ask, even with a short No or N/A, so the team can see it was covered.
  • Put amounts in their own boxes (HOI, Taxes) and payoff details in full.
  • Watch the clock. Green means the team has it.
  • Mark it Closed or Cancelled when the deal ends, so Open stays a true to-do list.
  • Cancel rather than delete, unless it's a mistake like a mistyped address.
  • Keep seller details inside the company. Only share printouts with people on the deal.

14Quick Answers

QuestionAnswer
It says Access Denied.Sign in with your @totalchb.com Google account, not a personal one.
Where did Load Cloud Save and Reset Call go?Every property is on the Properties page now; click one to open it. For the next call, click New Property.
I mistyped the address.Create it again with the right address, copy anything you'd entered, then delete the wrong one.
The clock is red.Check your internet connection. It keeps retrying; click the clock, then Retry Now. Don't close the page until it's green.
I can't delete a property.Only Team Leaders and Managers can, with the TC Team Leader password. Mark it Cancelled, or ask your Team Leader.
Where did the tick boxes go?You don't need them: typing an answer marks the question done. Put No or N/A if there's nothing to say.
A question shows done but its box is empty.It was ticked in the earlier version, which still counts.
I can't type in a property.It's Closed or Cancelled, so it's view-only. Click Reopen if it needs work.
A teammate's answer isn't showing.It appears within a second or two. If not, check the clock and your connection, then reload.
The printout cut something off.It shouldn't: every answer prints in full. Make sure you used Print / PDF in the app, not the browser's own print.
It looks different from a teammate's screen.One of you has an older version: do a hard reload (section 12).
Someone shows as an email-style name.Their department isn't brought over from the hub. A manager can add it.
Does it work on my phone?Yes, with the same link and sign-in (section 11).
Who sees my changes?Everyone on the team, immediately. Your name is recorded as the last person to update the property.

★Quick Reference Card

Print this page and keep it at your desk.

I want to…Do this
Start a first callProperties → New Property → type the address → Create → paste the CRM Lead Link.
Find a propertyProperties → pick the tab → type in Search (address, CRM link or any answer).
Record an answerType it in the box under the question. It saves by itself, and the circle turns green.
Escrow amountsMonthly Escrow Payments → HOI and Taxes boxes.
See everythingExpand All. Close it up again with Collapse All.
Print or PDFPrint / PDF → printer, or Save as PDF.
Deal closedStatus → Mark Closed → confirm.
Deal fell throughStatus → Mark Cancelled → confirm.
Work on it againOpen it → Reopen.
Remove a mistakeAsk your Team Leader, or Status → Mark Cancelled.
Something looks oldCtrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac). Phone: close and reopen.
Find this guideClick your initials → Help.

The Live clock's colours

Green: LiveEverything is saved for the team.
Purple: Saving…A change is on its way.
Red: Offline / Not SavedWaiting or retrying; click the clock for Retry Now.

Statuses

OpenBeing worked. Every property starts here.
ClosedThe deal closed. View-only until reopened.
CancelledThe deal fell through. View-only until reopened.

  1. Go to tc.totalchb.com and bookmark it (or install it: section 11).
  2. Click Sign In With Google and pick your @totalchb.com account.
  3. You stay signed in on that browser.
  4. On a shared computer, click your initials at the top right, then Sign Out, and confirm.
Tip. A personal Gmail or any other account is turned away with "Access Denied. @totalchb.com emails only." Sign in again with your company account.

5Starting A New Property

Start one as soon as the first call is booked.

  1. On the Properties page, click New Property.
  2. Type the property address exactly as it should appear, for example 1420 Sample Palm Dr, Exampleton FL 33000.
  3. Click Create. The checklist opens, ready for the call.
  4. Paste the GoHighLevel lead into CRM Lead Link at the top.
Important. The address can't be changed after it's created, because it's how the property is saved. If you make a typo, create the property again with the right address and delete the wrong one (section 10).
Good to know. If the address already exists, Create simply opens it, so you never get two copies of the same property.
An old unsaved checklist. If you'd started a checklist before version 2 without typing an address, a yellow note on the Properties page offers Start A Property With It, which brings those answers into a new property.

6Working The First Call

  1. Work down the sections. Each one shows how many of its questions are answered (for example 6 / 7), with a bar that fills as you go. A finished section turns green.
  2. Click a section's title to open or close it. Expand All and Collapse All are at the top.
  3. Type the seller's answer in the box under the question. It grows to fit long answers.
  4. As soon as a box has text, the question is done: its circle turns green with a check. Empty it, and the question is open again. There's nothing to tick.
  5. Paste a link (photos, a statement, a listing) and an open-link button appears in the box.
  6. Under What is The Monthly Escrow Payments, put the HOI and Taxes amounts in their own boxes.
Done = answered. An answer is what marks a question done. If the seller has nothing to add, type a short answer such as No, N/A or Not yet, so the team can see it was asked. Spaces alone don't count.
Good to know. The escrow question is done when any of its boxes has text: its own answer, HOI or Taxes. Questions that were ticked in the earlier version still count as done, even if their box is empty.
Tip. Mobile Homes: treat it like an SFH with all those questions, then add the Mobile Homes ones.

7Saving And Working Together

There is no Save button. Every answer saves on its own, a moment after you stop typing.

The Live clock at the top shows it. Click the clock for the details and when a change was last saved.

The clock isWhat it means
Green and glowing (Live)Everything is saved for the whole team.
Purple (Saving…)A change is on its way.
Red (Offline)No answer from the server yet. Your changes wait here and go through as soon as you're back online.
Red (Not Saved)The change didn't reach the server. It keeps trying on its own; click the clock, then Retry Now to try straight away. Nothing you typed is thrown away.
  • Teammates see your answers as you type, and you see theirs, without reloading.
  • Two people on the same property: each answer is saved on its own, so nobody overwrites anyone. The box you're typing in is never changed under you.
  • Leaving while it says Saving…: the browser asks you to wait. Let it finish.

8Closing Or Cancelling A Property

When a deal closes or falls through, take it off the Open list.

  1. Open the property and click Status: Open.
  2. Pick Mark Closed or Mark Cancelled, then confirm.
  3. It moves to the Closed or Cancelled tab and becomes view-only: nobody can change it by accident.
  4. To work on it again, open it and click Reopen.

9Printing Or Saving A PDF

For the deal file, or to send to someone on the deal.

  1. Open the property and click Print / PDF.
  2. In the print window, pick your printer, or Save as PDF as the destination.
  • The top shows the address, CRM link, status, how many questions are answered, when it was last updated and when it was printed.
  • Every answer prints in full, however long.
  • Sections with nothing filled in are left out, to keep it short.
Important. The printout holds the seller's details. Keep it inside the company and only send it to people on the deal.

10Deleting A Property

Deleting removes the property and every answer for the whole team, for good. Most of the time, Mark Cancelled is the better choice: it's off the Open list but still there if you need it.

Deleting follows the Team Hub's rules: only Team Leaders and Managers can delete a property, with the TC Team Leader password (the same one as in the Team Hub). Anyone with their own delete password uses that instead, and Remy only confirms.

  1. Open the property and click Delete.
  2. Type the TC Team Leader password (or your own delete password, if you have one). The passwords you may use are below.
  3. Click Delete. A wrong password is refused, and nothing is deleted.

Your delete passwords

Important. Keep the passwords to yourself, and never put them in a note, a message or an email. They're the same in the Team Hub. Members can't see them.
Changing a password. The passwords are set in the Team Hub's Vercel setting HUB_DELETE_PASSWORDS. Change one there and both apps use it straight away.

11On A Phone

Same link, same sign-in. The header is one row: the logo, the Live clock (time only) and your initials. Who's Online and the Light / Dark switch are in your photo menu. Menus slide up from the bottom, and answer boxes use a larger text size so the phone doesn't zoom in.

Tip. To put it on your home screen: in Safari tap Share → Add to Home Screen; in Chrome open the three-dot menu → Install app or Add to Home screen.

12Getting The Newest Version

TC Checklist checks for a new version every time it opens. When one arrives while you're using it, a note says A New Version Is Ready: click Reload.

Tip. If something looks out of date, do a hard reload once: Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac. On a phone, close the app fully and open it again.

14Good Habits

  • Start the property before the call, with the CRM link, so the team can find it.
  • Answer every question you ask, even with a short No or N/A, so the team can see it was covered.
  • Put amounts in their own boxes (HOI, Taxes) and payoff details in full.
  • Watch the clock. Green means the team has it.
  • Mark it Closed or Cancelled when the deal ends, so Open stays a true to-do list.
  • Cancel rather than delete, unless it's a mistake like a mistyped address.
  • Keep seller details inside the company. Only share printouts with people on the deal.
